summary_en: 380,000 shares (3.1% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 24 Jun 2026 at ¥1,705/share (closing price 23 Jun 2026). Upper limit ¥647.9M. Single-day purchase window (8:45 AM JST). Partial or full non-execution possible depending on market conditions.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and repurchase of treasury shares via off-exchange trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Kuribayashi Steamship announced on 23 June 2026 (at a board meeting) its intention to acquire 380,000 shares of its own ordinary stock via off-exchange trading (ToSTNeT-3) on 24 June 2026. The shares will be purchased at the closing price of 23 June 2026 (¥1,705 per share, inclusive of special quoting). The order is to be placed at 8:45 AM JST, limited to the single trading session of that time window. The upper limit on total acquisition is ¥647.9 million. The company holds 12,352,945 shares outstanding (excluding treasury); the 380,000-share program equals 3.1% of that base. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment. Results will be disclosed after the close of trading on 24 June. Partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions.
